Why complete monthly bills? Move-in, move-out, and partial bills don't show your typical usage, so savings estimates would be unreliable. We need regular billing cycles to give you accurate results.

100% client-side processing: Your bill PDF is read by your browser using PDF.js. All parsing, calculations, and analysis happen on your device. Nothing is uploaded to any server. No data is stored anywhere except temporarily in your browser's memory.
